title: relationships cardinality cascading and owned types
concepts: An EF relationship maps a principal-to-dependent association using foreign-key values and optional navigations. Cardinality, requiredness, and key choice determine what the model can represent.

Navigations are object-oriented access paths; the foreign key is the persisted relational link. EF conventions discover common patterns, while fluent API configuration resolves ambiguity and unusual schemas.
Delete behavior has database and client-side forms. Cascades and orphan deletion can affect more rows than the immediate operation; provider constraints and multiple cascade paths matter.

Owned entity types share an owner identity and lifecycle; EF Core complex types represent value-like structures without separate entity identity. JSON mapping and table splitting have distinct provider and version support.
Relationship fix-up keeps tracked navigation and foreign-key values consistent within a context; it does not load missing related rows automatically.

items: EF Core 10 supports complex-type JSON mapping. EF Core 11 adds further complex-type and complex-collection support while still in development at the checked date; label those features preview-only.
